verdict.rationale: Stripe Checkout lets customers enter payment details on a fully featured page reached by redirect to a Stripe-hosted page, built with prebuilt UIs through the Checkout Sessions API. Payment Links add a no-code hosted option that adapts to local language, currency and payment method, and these hosted integrations keep card data off your servers. Missing for 10: no explicit evidence of conversion optimization (e.g. conversion metrics or optimization features), and no independent or hands-on corroboration of the hosted checkout experience.
